content: प्लव {%a.%} [प्लु अच्] .²1 Swimming, floating. .²2 Jumping, leaping. .²3 <ab>Ved.</ab> Superior, excellent. .{@-वः@} Swimming, floating. .²2 Flood, swelling of a river. .²3 A jump, leap; going by leaps or jumps; ते रथैर्देवधिष्ण्याभैर्हयैश्च तरलप्लवैः <ls>Bhāg. 10. 82. 7</ls>. .²4 A raft, float, canoe, small boat; नावश्चारुरुहुस्त्वन्ये प्लवैस्तेरुस्तथापरे <ls>Rām. 2. 89. 20</ls> (<ab>com.</ab> प्लवा वेणुतृणादिनिर्मिताः); नाशयेच्च शनैः पश्चात् प्लवं सलिलपूरवत् <ls>Pt. 2. 42</ls>; सर्वं ज्ञानप्लवेनैव वृजिनं संतरिष्यसि <ls>Bg. 4. 36</ls>; <ls>Ms. 4. 194</ls>, <ls n="Ms.">11. 19</ls>; <ls>Ve. 3. 25</ls>. .²5 A frog; हंसक्रौञ्चप्लवाकीर्णं सारसैः संप्रसादितम् <ls>Rām. 3. 35. 18</ls>. .²6 A monkey; दधि हृत्वा बकश्चापि प्लवो मत्स्यानसंस्कृतान् <ls>Mb. 13. 111. 99</ls>. .²7 A declivity, slope. .²8 An enemy. .²9 A sheep. .²10 A man of a low tribe, a Chāṇḍāla. .²11 A net or snare for catching fish. .²12 The fig-tree. .²13 The Kāraṇḍava bird, a kind of duck. .²14 Five or more stanzas syntactically connected (= कुलक <ab>q. v.</ab>). .²15 The prolated utterance of a vowel. .²16 Returning, return. .²17 Urging on, inciting. .²18 Sound; <ls>L. D. B.</ls> .²19 A kind of aquatic bird; <ls>Ms. 5. 12</ls>. .²20 <ab>N.</ab> of a संवत्सर.
